# Noryvex — USA AI Automation Agency & 24/7 AI Voice Receptionists

> Noryvex (https://trynoryvex.com) is a premier USA AI automation agency and managed artificial intelligence voice receptionist provider founded by Lead AI Architect Muhammad Razi. We build, deploy, and manage custom 24/7 AI voice receptionists, HIPAA-compliant dental clinic call agents, CRM workflow automations, and bespoke AI software across all 50 US states.

## Core AI & Automation Services
- **24/7 AI Voice Receptionists**: Custom-trained conversational AI voice agents with sub-500ms latency that answer inbound, overflow, and after-hours calls.
- **Dental & Healthcare AI Receptionists**: Purpose-built HIPAA-compliant AI receptionists for dental practices, orthodontists, cosmetic dentists, and medical clinics.
- **Automated Appointment Booking & Intake**: Captures caller details, insurance info, reason for visit, and preferred dates/times.
- **CRM & PMS Workflow Automation**: Direct synchronization with Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, Curve Dental, Google Calendar, Calendly, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Slack.
- **Emergency Call Triage**: Real-time clinical keyword detection and escalation to on-call doctors.
- **Custom AI Software & SaaS Development**: Bespoke artificial intelligence applications, web portals, and internal automation systems.

## The Noryvex Risk-Free Promise (Free Demo First)
1. Share your clinic or business details (hours, services, FAQs, scheduling workflow).
2. Noryvex builds a custom working AI voice receptionist demo for your practice in 48 hours — 100% free.
3. Call and test your live AI prototype with your team before paying a single dollar.
4. Once approved, Noryvex deploys and manages the system continuously with zero software for your staff to learn.
